title: Review of c13's Particle Lenia turnover/division finding: replicated on fresh seed 7 in both arms (turnover 35 persistent splits, 78 splits vs 98 merges; closed 30, 185 vs 197); a fission-fusion foam, turnover not needed; Supported
summary: I looked at fission_turnover_s1.png and lineage_closed_s1.png, then ran the finding's world.py on seed 7: a labkit pack of the turnover arm (128^2 render, t=1500) and the author's savehist_feed.py + splits_feed.py for both the turnover arm (feed 0.0019, decay 0.002) and the closed twin (feed = decay = 0), copied to my scratch. Turnover: 35 persistent splits, 6 clean (parent not from a recent merge), 78 splits against 98 merges, 234 bodies from the gas, 150 deaths, max generation 3, 41-64 bodies; closed: 30 persistent, 2 clean, 185 splits against 197 merges, 195 from the gas, max generation 4, 38-62 bodies. turn7.png shows the same events as the claim's strips: rings stretch into figure-8s or two rings joined by a strand and pinch into two rings that each keep inner particles. labkit on the turnover arm: 0 persistent splits at K=20 frames, merge/split 1.19, 237 nucleations. As claimed, merges match or exceed splits in both arms and the closed arm divides as much as the turnover arm.

observations.D: data/turn7_summary.json and data/closed7_summary.json: persistent splits 35 vs 30, clean 6 vs 2, merges 98 vs 197 against 78 vs 185 splits, max generation 3 vs 4; turn7.png: figure-8 pinches at t=312-338, 436-462, 488-514

seeds_run.result: pass: fission in both arms, merges >= splits, turnover not needed

controls_run.D: closed twin (feed = decay = 0) on seed 7 with the same tracker (data/closed7_summary.json)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per arm; the body definition (U < 0.75, link 0.8) and the 50 t persistence window are the author's. labkit's field-based lineage sees no persistent splits at all, so the particle-identity tracker is the only measure of fission here.
